jobs.full_tracked_by: justified while gold.parcel_public_auction is under 10,000 rows and its run under 10 minutes: the run is mostly Spark start and the lineage walk (about 85 s, root ADR-0312), which a partial build pays too; past either bound, map the item Silver's appended rows to PNUs (root ADR-0312 §2)
jobs.description: 공매 kind Gold (root ADR-0287; scripts/ops/gold-panel-rebuild.sh parcel-public-auction): gold.parcel_public_auction from the Onbid item history, once a day after the night's item passes, the rounds open as of the build placed on their PNUs, each carried to the current legal-dong code on every build through reference.legal_dong_code_change (root ADR-0383; lineage and merges followed, lineage_missing kept). Its own job because its Silver commits hourly: as an input of gold_kind_rebuild it would start that job, and the bake, every hour. by_pnu_serving_bake serves its commit.

Reflect each new Gold snapshot of gold.parcel_public_auction (the own-producer public-auction kind, root ADR-0287) in R2 by-PNU serving (scripts/ops/by-pnu-serving-bake.sh parcel-public-auction), as section packs (root ADR-0147, ADR-0193 §9): a change set decides a create-only patch, a reflect-only manifest or a full new generation, exactly as the panel bake does per lane. Its own job so it bakes concurrently with the panel/parcel bake instead of waiting behind it in `by_pnu_serving_bake all` (root ADR-0303): a slow national parcel re-bake no longer holds public-auction serving for hours (2026-10-28). Own-producer because its servability is resolved at Gold: servable() keeps only the PNUs the served parcel edition carries, which the Gold build reads from Silver (root ADR-0292); the bake reads no parcel lane state, so a PNU of a parcel edition not served yet may 404 until the parcel lane catches up (accepted, root ADR-0303 §2). Started when gold_public_auction_rebuild commits a new snapshot, and at 10:45 as the fallback (root ADR-0171), apart from the panel bake's 10:15 so the two clock starts do not crowd the host at once; each run's containers are its own one-offs (tools/semgrep/rules/batch-containers.yml). It does not take turns: one slot for at most two hours, which the folds run beside and FLOOR waits out within the pool's starvation bound. One slot and MemoryMax=5G, so it runs beside the panel bake inside the host memory budget (root ADR-0138).

assets.title: 필지 공매 by-PNU 표
assets.description: PNU마다 빌드 시각에 열려 있는 온비드 공매 회차를 마감이 이른 순서로 담는 데이터 종류 표(루트 ADR-0287). 계약의 종류 한 줄(parcel-public-auction)이 자기 생산자를 이름 짓고, 필지 패널이 아니라 온비드 Silver 에서 만든다. 폐지된 PNU 의 회차는 필지 이력과 합병을 따라 지금 필지에 더해진다.

assets.title: 필지 공매 by-PNU 묶음 파일
assets.description: gold.parcel_public_auction 의 PNU 문서를 법정동 묶음으로만 굽는다. 필지 호스트의 Worker 가 /parcels/public-auction/by-pnu/ 경로로 서빙한다(루트 ADR-0193, ADR-0287). 첫 발행은 비용 승인 뒤 운영자의 묶음 전용 관문을 거친다.

dependencies.description: 자기 생산자를 가진 종류(루트 ADR-0287): 물건 이력 전체에서 회차마다 PNU 를 정하고, 열린 회차만 PNU 문서로 묶는다. 필지 패널에 고정되지 않고 늘 전량 생성한다.
회차의 사진·감정평가서(photos[])와 물건의 위치도·지적도·360·동영상(items[].media[])을 내용해시로 싣는다.
같은 물건의 끝난 회차 결과(유찰·낙찰가·입찰자 수·개찰일시)를 items[].history[] 로 싣는다(루트 ADR-0340 §7).
회차가 이름 짓는 공고 회차의 공고명·기관·담당부점·공고일·개찰일시를 announcements[] 로 싣는다(루트 ADR-0340 §7).
공고 회차의 개찰 집행상태를 announcements[] 에 더한다(루트 ADR-0340 §7).
공고문 전문(상한 안)·첨부(내용해시)·참가자격·취소사유를 announcements[] 에 더한다(루트 ADR-0340 §7).
입찰정보(입찰보증금·잔대금·제한·제출서류·평가·이전 회차·회차별 일정)를 items[].bid_info 로 싣는다(루트 ADR-0340 §7).
공매 회차의 PNU 를 짓기마다 정본 해석기의 쌍으로 현재 법정동 코드에 옮긴다. 이 표가 바뀌면 바뀐 코드(views.changed_codes) 아래 회차가 닿는 PNU 만 다시 만든다(루트 ADR-0383, ADR-0329 §3).

revisions.reason: the first served document: a parcel's open onbid rounds, the Gold JSON column as written
each round gains its media index (rounds[].photos[], content-addressed by sha256), an optional field: an expansion of revision 1 served under its own string before the registry existed

every collected Onbid field a buyer reads, all optional: each round gains the rest of its list row (the provider's code names, bid conditions, organisations); the document gains items[] (detail with the 공매재산명세서, tenancy, occupancy, rights, areas, corrections and appraisals; bid information with earlier rounds and every round's schedule; closed rounds' results; maps) and announcements[] (text, attachments, organisation, opening), once each for the rounds that name them

each round photo gains its full-size original (rounds[].photos[].original: sha256, media_format, size_bytes), an optional object: the photo's own file is the provider's 178x134 thumbnail (measured 2026-11-06)
